description.value: A classification framework using structural MRI, FLAIR-derived grading features, CSF biomarkers, feature selection, and RUSBoost to distinguish five neurodegenerative diagnostic classes.

spans.text: The purpose of this study is to develop a classification framework for distinguishing the four most common neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, frontotemporal lobe degeneration, Dementia with Lewy bodies and vascular dementia, as well as patients with subjective memory complaints.
